Count the observations a transition tree was fitted on

Source: R/likelihood.R
nobs.transitiontrees.Rd

nobs() returns the number of observed positions in the sequences the tree was fitted on, the number used by BIC(). For a weighted fit it is the weighted total. A held-out log-likelihood, logLik(tree, newdata), carries its own count of scored positions.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'transitiontrees'
nobs(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A transitiontrees object.

...

Not used.

Value

A single integer.

See also

logLik.transitiontrees(), model_fit().

Examples

tree <- context_tree(trajectories, max_depth = 2)
nobs(tree)
#> [1] 1870
